claim: One physical Steam Deck Serum 2 touch-popup session under the shared per-window Wine X11 touch route
fixture: Steam Deck Desktop Mode, Bitwig 6.1, physical touchscreen and trackpad, disposable project
operator_sequence: Opened Serum once and heard a note before touching the waveform menu.
Trackpad opened and selected or dismissed the waveform menu; it closed and the editor remained responsive.
One ordinary finger-operated control responded; the editor remained responsive.
Finger tap opened the waveform popup; after full lift, a second finger tap selected a visible item. The popup closed and editor remained responsive without focus cycling.
Finger reopened the popup; a second finger tap outside dismissed it. Editor remained responsive.
One following note was audible. Bitwig closed normally without saving the disposable project.
nonclaims: This one session does not establish a universal Wine touch fix or all Serum menus and gestures.
It does not establish Blackhole, Kontakt, or Pigments touch behavior.
It does not establish project save/reopen under candidate D or a general gap-free guarantee.
